content: I deeply regret purchasing this foam mattress; it's been an utterly miserable experience. The initial comfort quickly faded, and now I wake up stiff and sore every morning. The mattress sags terribly in the middle, leaving both my partner and me feeling like we're sleeping in a valley. Its advertised "cooling" properties are a complete joke, as it traps heat and makes us sweat throughout the night. The edges are flimsy and offer no support, making it difficult to get in and out of bed. Furthermore, the overall quality feels cheap and poorly constructed. Save your money and headache; avoid this flimsy excuse for a mattress at all costs. I wish I could get a refund.
